admission.justification: Omitting post-registration compaction or running it out of order relative to explainer registration and role narrowing leaves uncompacted tool schemas and clips Manager tools above the 48,312 B pack cap; guarded by server parity, budget, and stdio tests.

applicability: Applies to every FastMCP server constructed by create_server(config) in mcp/src/agents_remember/mcp/server.py across unbound, role-bound, and explainer configurations.
conditions: Runs once over the entire registered surface immediately after apply_read_only_marks and before _bound_role_tools / _scope_server_tools.
exclusions: Does not alter FastMCP fn_metadata.arg_model runtime Pydantic validation, tool registration order, read-only annotations, or role allowlists.
statement: create_server compacts every registered tool's advertised inputSchema in place immediately after apply_read_only_marks and before role narrowing, covering unbound, role-bound, and explainer tools without changing runtime Pydantic validation, tool order, or read-only annotations.
